memories.text: Talked with Lina: Lina: The beans are climbing! / Greta: They need poles.
Talked with Jonas at the market: Jonas: Fish for your carrots? / Greta: Gladly.
Talked with Hilde: Hilde: The trees by the square need water. / Greta: I'll help.
Talked with Lina: Lina: Hot day tomorrow. / Greta: Then I start early.
Talked with Jonas: Jonas: The lake is low. / Greta: The fields are dry too.
Talked with Hilde: Hilde: Can you weed by the town hall? / Greta: After noon.
Talked with Lina at the market: Lina: Sold all my roses! / Greta: Well done.
Talked with Jonas: Jonas: Mended the nets. / Greta: My hoe needs mending.
Talked with Hilde: Hilde: The meeting is tomorrow at five. / Greta: I'll come.
Talked with Lina: Lina: Sleep well! / Greta: You too.
The harvest festival on the square with Lina and Jonas. The stalls held fish, vegetables and flowers.
You looked back on your day: The festival needs vegetables early; bring them to the stalls.
